title: Keggin-Type H<sub>5</sub>PMo<sub>10</sub>V<sub>2</sub>O<sub>40</sub> Intercalated MgAl-LDH: Structural Integrity and Bifunctional Electrocatalytic Activity
authors: Pushparaj Loganathan, Kalathiparambil Rajendra Pai Sunajadevi, Devaraj Muthukumar
abstract: Keggin-type polyoxometalates (H₅PMo₁₀V₂O₄₀) intercalated into MgAl layered double hydroxides (LDH) display exceptional structural integrity and robust bifunctional electrocatalytic performance for overall water splitting in alkaline media.
keyFindings: Bifunctional electrocatalytic activity for both OER and HER
Intercalation maintains structural stability during prolonged electrocatalysis
Synergistic electron transfer across the POM-LDH heterojunction

title: Utilizing Highly Reactive Lewis Pairs Generated by Oxygen Vacancies in the Cu<sub>3</sub>Mo<sub>2</sub>O<sub>9</sub> Solid Catalyst for Cycloaddition of CO<sub>2</sub> to 1,2-Propanediol
authors: S. Sujith, B. J. Vaishnavi, K. M. Rajashekhar Vaibhava, Kalathiparambil Rajendra Pai Sunajadevi, Ganapati V. Shanbhag
abstract: Highly reactive frustrated Lewis pairs created by oxygen vacancies in Cu₃Mo₂O₉ catalysts facilitate efficient cycloaddition of CO₂ to 1,2-propanediol under solvent-free conditions.
keyFindings: Oxygen-vacancy engineered Lewis acid-base active sites
High catalytic conversion of industrial CO₂ into cyclic carbonate
Excellent reusability and catalyst stability over multiple cycles

title: Harnessing MOF Derived Frustrated Lewis Pair-CeO<sub>2</sub> Nano Catalyst for CO<sub>2</sub>-Activated Soft Oxidation of Furfural to Furoic Acid
authors: S. Sujith, H. K. Meghana, M. Harsha, B. J. Vaishnavi, Chaitra N. Mallannavar, Kalathiparambil Rajendra Pai Sunajadevi, Ganapati V. Shanbhag
abstract: MOF-templated synthesis of CeO₂ nanocatalysts with active frustrated Lewis pairs enables CO₂-promoted soft oxidation of biomass-derived furfural into furoic acid.
keyFindings: MOF derivative featuring tailored Frustrated Lewis Pair active sites
CO₂-activated catalytic pathway for mild biomass oxidation
High yield conversion of furfural to value-added furoic acid

title: ZIF-8/LDH Nanohybrids for Dye Adsorption: LDH Composition-Dependent Structure and Adsorption Performance
authors: Pushparaj Loganathan, Kalathiparambil Rajendra Pai Sunajadevi, Marimuthu Priyadarshini, Cheriyan John, Sankar Sathish, Kanakarasu Dharmaraj
abstract: ZIF-8 MOF integrated with layered double hydroxide (LDH) nanohybrids presents tailored porosity and composition-dependent structural stability for rapid dye decontamination.
keyFindings: Synergistic composite architecture combining ZIF-8 and LDH
Composition-tunable surface area and active adsorption sites
High removal rates for organic dyes in industrial effluent treatment
